image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a baby doll lying on its back on a textured surface (possibly a changing pad or bed). The doll is wearing a blue onesie that is pulled down to reveal a disposable diaper. The diaper has a white outer shell with light blue patterns and distinct elastic leg gathers. To the right, there is a purple plush toy and some blue fabric. In the foreground, a clear plastic container edge is visible.

The transition where the blue onesie meets the diaper waistband is slightly ambiguous. The fabric folds don't fully resolve logically, suggesting minor geometric confusion in how the garments layer.
The weave of the brown mat/surface in the background warps slightly near the edges of the frame, inconsistent with a rigid camera lens perspective.

To verify the boundary integrity of the diaper, ensuring the elastic ruffles are connected properly to the main body and not floating or melting into the legs.
